title: Tongue and Lips (TaL) Corpus
publication: Ribeiro et al. 2021, TaL: a synchronised multi-speaker corpus of ultrasound tongue imaging, audio, and lip videos; DOI 10.1109/SLT48900.2021.9383619
production_type: read and spontaneous speech; synchronized audio; ultrasound tongue imaging; lip video
manual_evidence: Authors transcribed all spontaneous utterances and manually annotated boundaries of shorter 5-10 s segments; deposited .lab files contain start/end seconds and transcription
available_primary_data: TaL1 and TaL80 public via UltraSuite rsync; .wav .sync .ult .param .mp4 .txt and spontaneous .lab annotations
notes: Accept qualifying manual spontaneous-speech segmentation/transcription plus its linked primary articulatory/audio streams. Corpus has 82 native English speakers: TaL1 one professional speaker across six sessions and TaL80 81 speakers. About 24 h parallel data / 13.5 h speech. Do not treat automatic downstream alignments as manual; retain read prompts as primary recordings but manual-annotation eligibility is specifically established for spontaneous .lab segments. Large 49 GB TaL1 and 498 GB TaL80 core archives remain authoritative remote references rather than GitHub payloads.
